purpose: Teach: いきさつ/参列/次女/釧路/憂慮/を以て/綴り/かんがみ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、明治維新のいきさつを論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered the circumstances of the Meiji Restoration in your paper.
lines.style: Warm, attentive. Slight pause before the student's name—genuine recognition. Measured pace. The tone of a teacher who's read carefully and wants to invite her student to expand.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、皇室の参列儀式の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I focused on the history of imperial ceremonial practices.
lines.style: Steady, respectful tone. Clear enunciation. A slight formality—Sakura's offering precision back to a teacher she trusts. Not defensive, just precise. Meeting professionalism with professionalism.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の家族構成、次女以下の進学傾向を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed postwar family structures and the educational trends of younger daughters in another piece.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity in the voice. Slower pace than the first line. Almost conversational—she's checking her notes and finding unexpected territory. A slight rise at the end, inviting correction or elaboration.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、釧路湿原の生態系を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I examined the ecosystem of the Kushiro Marshlands.
lines.style: Composed, matter-of-fact. Sakura's keeping steady eye contact here—no apology for the range. Each word weighted equally. A tiny bit of quiet confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国際情勢への憂慮の声明を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you wrote about the expressed concerns regarding the international situation.
lines.style: Reflective, almost mulling aloud. The gentlest of these lines. A pause mid-phrase. Teacher's noting the breadth, the seriousness. Wondering where this one went.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、憲法を以て国民の権利を守る論を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I explored the argument that the Constitution exists to protect citizens' rights.
lines.style: Voice steady but with slight warmth entering. Sakura's more grounded now—this topic matters to her. Clear articulation. No hesitation. The sincerity breaking through the formality.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古文書の綴り方の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also researched the orthography of historical documents.
lines.style: Paced even slower now. A slight smile in the voice—not laughing, but recognition of something. The teacher seeing the pattern. Respectful distance, but with a note of quiet admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、先例にかんがみる司法判断を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I focused on judicial reasoning informed by legal precedent.
lines.style: Calm close. Voice lands with quiet finality—not defensive, just complete. Sakura's given her full answer. Small breath at the very end. The sense of someone who's found her footing and knows it.
